messages:
maya: Heads-up — did a quick pass on the playground structured-output + tool-calling surfaces. Small copy tweaks and a11y nits. I’ll drop Figma screenshots later but wanted quick feedback now.

oliver: Thanks — can you paste the most annoying lines? is this mostly about run history or the schema editor / fn defs?

maya: Mostly run history + the function-def inspector. Observations: 1) 'Invoked tools' copy reads awkwardly when it's a single tool — 'Tools used' or 'Tool calls' feels clearer. 2) The schema badge overlaps long fn names in compact view. 3) Keyboard focus order breaks when expanding a run.

chen: +1 on 'Tools used'. For long names we should ellipsize visually and expose full text via tooltip + aria-label for screen readers. The focus order thing is a real regression on VoiceOver.

eva: For the ellipsis approach, we need to ensure the tooltip is reachable by keyboard (focusable). Also the expand control should be first in the tab sequence of each run card so keyboard users don't have to tab past metadata.

oliver: Good call. Proposal: move the expand chevron into the run header and make it a button with aria-expanded. That keeps semantics clear and simplifies keyboard flow. :thumbsup:

sam: Quick copy nit — we use both 'Return value' and 'Output' across the UI. Recommend standardizing on 'Output' (shorter, matches API docs).

maya: Also noticed the play/pause streaming control in the inspector has no aria-pressed or accessible label. Suggest aria-pressed + aria-label like 'Pause streaming for this run'.

designbot: Auto-diff suggestion: compact the run history row to 'Prompt — Tools used — Tokens 324 — 120ms' with optional chips for tokens/latency. Current rows feel visually heavy.

chen: One more: when a tool returns structured JSON, we default to raw JSON expansion. Could we default to schema preview and provide a 'Show raw' toggle? That would reduce noise for common cases.

maya: Agree — collapsible schema-first view is better. For the fn-def editor, can we show required params with a red asterisk and inline example text (muted) under each param? Little examples cut down on guesswork.

oliver: I'll sketch a quick prototype with the chevron/header-change + schema-first default. Will try to include sample keyboard flows.

eva: I added a tiny test run in the playground with long function names + nested JSON to exercise edges: https://playground/redwood/test-run/172777 — contains 'order_items_with_extra_verbose_name_v2' and nested receipt.

maya: Awesome, thanks. I’ll open a PR for the copy updates + aria-labels after oliver drops the prototype. Assigning follow-ups: oliver (prototype), chen (a11y verification), designbot (density diff).

oliver: Sounds good — will post a Loom of the prototype by EOD.

maya: :rocket:
